text:
Jordyn (CS): quick ping 19 - a handful of EU onboarding flows are returning 401s during SSO handoff. blocking activations for several trials and one renewal-focused account. need ETA before I message customers.
Marco (Platform): looking now. which region and how many tenants?
Jordyn (CS): eu-west-1, 7 tenants in the ticket (high-touch flagged). Pri has the priority mapping.
Pri (AM): confirmed, 2 of those are high renewal risk. will prep exec notes if incident >2h.
Asha (SRE): initial trace points to identity-proxy v2.2.0 change. some requests are losing the Authorization header when proxied. suspect header parsing regression.
Marco (Platform): rollback path exists. proposing a canary undo to v2.1.3, validate auth logs, then full rollback. ETA to restore for affected tenants ~20-35m.
Jordyn (CS): drafting an interim note for affected customers. please review: "Hi - were aware of an authentication issue affecting some EU onboarding activations. Engineers are investigating and expect service restoration within ~30 minutes. If youre blocked please reply to this thread or join troubleshooting office hours at 11:15 UTC (calendar link). We apologize for the interruption; we will follow up with remediation steps."
Renee (Legal): interim wording fine. avoid promising credits in the initial message; include support alias.
Asha (SRE): add to the note that we can trigger manual activation re-runs for impacted customers as a temporary workaround. ops can run those per-tenant.
Marco (Platform): executing rollback: `kubectl -n onboarding rollout undo deployment/identity-proxy --to-revision=3`
InfraBot: rollback started for deployment "identity-proxy" by marco.platform at 3832105610. details: https://k8s.console/rollouts/identity-proxy
Asha (SRE): canary healthy (2/2). rolling out to remaining pods. monitoring auth success rates now.
Jordyn (CS): sending interim to affected tenant contacts and scheduling a 30-min office hours slot. adding conditional credit for trials to reduce churn risk (drafting language per legal).
Pri (AM): support the conditional 2-week credit + 1:1 enablement session for trials. I'll prep the calendar invite.
Renee (Legal): conditional credit OK if phrased: "If your activation was affected, we will offer a service credit and a dedicated enablement session." keep it conditional.
Asha (SRE): rollback complete, auth errors returned to baseline. root cause: header parsing change in v2.2.0 that dropped Authorization for specific multi-segment requests. fix path: revert change in v2.2.1 candidate + add integration test ensuring header passthrough; add post-deploy header probe.
Marco (Platform): opening PR for revert and tests; will add deploy guard.
Jordyn (CS): CS action list: 1) interim sent (done), 2) send full RCA/update in ~45m with timeline + conditional credit details + one-click calendar for enablement, 3) offer manual re-run for impacted activations, 4) collect feedback with short survey (survey link). flag renewal-risk accounts to AMs.
Pri (AM): I'll start outreach to renewal-risk accounts after the RCA goes out. prepping exec-ready summary.
Asha (SRE): postmortem owners: marco.platform (code + tests), asha.sre (deploy + verification), jordyn.cs (customer comms), pri.am (renewal outreach). will capture timeline and follow-up mitigations.
Jordyn (CS): thanks team 30; posting RCA draft here shortly for sign-off.
